slides.title: why does busy feel safer than important?
slides.body:
for anyone who ended today tired
and unsure what they finished.

busy has a finish line every few minutes.
reply. tick. archive.

each one feels like a small win.

important work doesn't.
it is slow, unclear,
and easy to put off until tomorrow.

so we fill the day with small wins
and call it *progress.

try this tomorrow.

before you open the inbox,
write down the _one thing
that would make the day count.

do it first, even for 30 minutes.

then be as busy as you like.
